question: Does the deduplication treat uppercase and lowercase letters as the same character (case-insensitive), and does the appended 'h' check ignore case?
expect: If dedup is case-sensitive (current model): Aa -> Aah, aA -> aAh, Hh -> Hh, hH -> hH, AbA -> AbAh, aBa -> aBah, hHh -> hHh, HhH -> HhH, Apple -> Aplh, APPLE -> APLEh. If dedup is case-insensitive (keeping first case form): Aa -> Aah, aA -> aAh (same, since first char kept), Hh -> Hh, hH -> hH, AbA -> Abh (second A dropped), aBa -> aBh, hHh -> hH, HhH -> Hh, Apple -> Aplh, APPLE -> Aplh (or APLEh depending on which case kept). Differences on AbA, aBa, APPLE reveal case-folding in dedup; hHh/HhH reveal whether 'h' check is case-insensitive (if 'H' counts as h, no append).
